title: quick accent inserts `」` as `「` in the wechat desktop app
author: brauljo

judgment.rationale: The report gives a precise expected/actual pair and a concrete target, but the supplied diagnostic does not prove whether the picker selected U+300D or whether WeChat transformed correctly emitted Unicode input.
evidence: The issue reports U+300D `」` becoming U+300C `「` in WeChat Desktop on PowerToys 0.100.2.
The diagnostic shows Quick Accent enabled with Pinyin and usage sorting; usage data contains both U+300C and U+300D.
CharacterMappings.cs contains distinct Pinyin entries for U+300C and U+300D.
PowerAccent commits the selected string through a backspace followed by tagged KEYEVENTF_UNICODE SendInput.
The keyboard-service log records navigation/hide events but not the selected code point.
The related older selection report makes an adjacent-selection defect plausible, but does not establish that it affects this report.
judgment.recommended_action: Run the controlled current-version comparison and collect only the evidence that separates selection/index state from target/IME transformation.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked or fork-side implementation covers the issue. A conditional compatibility design is plausible, but the implementation branch must be selected after proving the committed code point and target behavior.

proposed_fixes.title: Disambiguate Quick Accent selection from WeChat Unicode delivery before implementing a fix
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Unconfirmed: either stale/reordered picker selection commits the adjacent U+300C entry, or WeChat/its active IME transforms a correctly emitted U+300D Unicode synthetic-input sequence.
plan: Select U+300D with Unicode descriptions visible and capture the value at the commit boundary.
Repeat the same selection in Notepad and compare literal clipboard paste in the same WeChat field.
If selection is wrong, make the displayed item, description, selected index, and committed string one toolbar-generation snapshot and add a regression test.

If selection is correct and only WeChat changes it, add a narrowly scoped opt-in clipboard fallback while retaining Unicode SendInput by default; protect clipboard, focus, modifier, and failure behavior.
verification: Compare U+300C, U+300D, U+300E, and U+300F in WeChat and Notepad under the same keyboard and IME state.
Paste literal `」` into the same WeChat control.
Verify the picker description, commit-boundary value, and resulting text agree; for a fallback verify clipboard preservation and no text loss on failure.

confidence.rationale: The candidate paths fit the observed code and archive, but the issue has no neutral-target comparison or event evidence proving the selected code point.

issue_context.summary: Quick Accent reportedly changes a selected closing corner bracket into an opening corner bracket only in WeChat Desktop.
known_information: The affected version is 0.100.2 and a diagnostic archive is attached to the upstream report.
Quick Accent is enabled with Pinyin, usage sorting, and start-selection-from-the-left enabled.
The Pinyin mapping includes U+300C and U+300D as separate entries.
The current insertion path sends a tagged backspace and UTF-16 KEYEVENTF_UNICODE key pairs.
No issue comments, assignees, linked PR, or concrete fix attempt were found.
inferences: The target or active IME may transform Unicode synthetic input, but this is not confirmed.
A mapping typo is less likely because both code points are present; selection/handoff remains unexcluded.
A universal clipboard fallback would create avoidable clipboard and focus risks.
issue_context.analysis: The diagnostic narrows the problem to picker selection/handoff versus target delivery, not to missing mapping data. A controlled picker/neutral-target/paste comparison is required before approving a code path.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body, labels, timestamps, and empty comment history.
Read the attached diagnostic in memory: Quick Accent settings, usage data, and the 2026-09-02 keyboard-service log were examined.
Inspected current CharacterMappings, PowerAccent selection/commit flow, WindowsFunctions.Insert, tests, and recent PowerAccent history.
Reviewed the related wrong-selection report as alternative evidence only.

information_gaps.information: Whether the current picker visibly selects U+300D and passes U+300D to the commit boundary.
information_gaps.why_needed: Without this, a target compatibility fix could mask a selection/index defect.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Enable Unicode descriptions, select U+300D, and capture the picker plus the resulting character; repeat on the current release.

information_gaps.information: Same-session U+300D results in WeChat, Notepad, and literal clipboard paste.
information_gaps.why_needed: This separates Quick Accent/SendInput behavior from WeChat or IME composition behavior.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Use the same keyboard layout and IME mode, repeat U+300C/U+300D/U+300E/U+300F, and paste literal `」` into the same WeChat field.

information_gaps.information: Exact WeChat version/install channel and active Windows input method/punctuation mode.
information_gaps.why_needed: The target control and IME state may determine whether the transformation occurs.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Record WeChat About details and the Windows input-language/IME state during reproduction.

design.root_cause: Not yet proven. Candidate A is a picker/index snapshot defect in PowerAccent.ProcessNextChar or the UI handoff, causing the adjacent U+300C to be committed. Candidate B is target/IME transformation of the correctly selected U+300D after WindowsFunctions.Insert emits KEYEVENTF_UNICODE input.

evidence.detail: src/modules/poweraccent/PowerAccent.Core/PowerAccent.cs, SendInputAndHideToolbar reads _characters[_selectedIndex] and calls WindowsFunctions.Insert(selected, true).
src/modules/poweraccent/PowerAccent.Core/Tools/WindowsFunctions.cs, Insert sends tagged backspace then KEYEVENTF_UNICODE key-down/up pairs.
The supplied 0.100.2 diagnostic log records toolbar navigation and hide events but no selected index/code point; usage data records both corner-bracket code points.
The identical visible symptom can result from adjacent selection or target-side transformation, so the fallback branch is not yet justified.

implementation_steps.current_flow: Navigation mutates _selectedIndex; UI receives an index/character event; commit later re-reads the mutable index and emits that array element after deleting the base character.
implementation_steps.change: First prove the commit-boundary value using a test seam or bounded diagnostic event. Keep a single selected-character snapshot for display and commit within one toolbar generation; do not add broad user-text logging.
implementation_steps.pseudo_diff:
- WindowsFunctions.Insert(_characters[_selectedIndex], true)
+ var selected = _characters[_selectedIndex];
+ commitObserver?.Invoke(selected); // test/diagnostic seam only
+ WindowsFunctions.Insert(selected, true)
implementation_steps.edge_handling: Preserve ForceReset, display cancellation, usage-frequency update, and UI-thread ordering. Reject stale callbacks after CancelToolbar and avoid exposing arbitrary user text in logs.
tests: Deterministic Pinyin punctuation navigation with usage sorting on/off
Assert picker description, selected value, and committed value all identify U+300D

implementation_steps.current_flow: Existing tests cover UI behavior but do not establish a WeChat-versus-neutral-target code-point comparison for this report.
implementation_steps.change: Add or document a focused test/manual matrix for U+300C/U+300D/U+300E/U+300F in Notepad and WeChat, plus literal clipboard paste, under identical IME state.
implementation_steps.edge_handling: Record WeChat version, installation channel, IME/punctuation mode, current PowerToys version, and whether the issue is target-only. Do not make CI depend on proprietary WeChat unless an existing harness supports it.
tests: Repeat with usage sorting and Pinyin-only settings

implementation_steps.current_flow: The UI stores its own selected index while the core stores another mutable index; usage sorting changes the displayed array before navigation.
implementation_steps.change: If commit-boundary evidence is U+300C when U+300D is visibly selected, use one immutable per-generation item snapshot or a validated index/value handoff so description, visual selection, and commit cannot diverge.
implementation_steps.pseudo_diff:
- OnSelectCharacter(index, character) -> UI index only
+ selection = new SelectionSnapshot(generation, index, character)
+ UI renders selection.character
+ commit validates generation and commits selection.character
implementation_steps.edge_handling: Handle cancellation, focus loss, delayed reveal, wrap-around, Shift navigation, and usage-sorted arrays without reindexing a stale snapshot.
tests: Regression for selecting U+300D after repeated navigation
Delayed reveal/cancellation does not commit stale item
Wrap-around and Shift navigation remain unchanged

implementation_steps.path: src/modules/poweraccent/PowerAccent.Core/Tools/WindowsFunctions.cs and target-policy/settings owner to be discovered only after reproduction
implementation_steps.current_flow: Unicode SendInput is the default insertion mechanism and deletes the base character first when back=true.
implementation_steps.change: Only if selection is proven correct and WeChat alone transforms input, add an explicit opt-in, narrowly scoped clipboard-paste compatibility path. Prepare clipboard before deletion, bound contention retries, restore prior clipboard where possible, send balanced Ctrl+V, and fail without deleting text if preparation/paste cannot complete.
implementation_steps.edge_handling: Protect clipboard ownership, focus changes, elevation boundaries, surrogate pairs, cancellation, and modifier key-up. Do not introduce a universal fallback or unverified WeChat heuristic.
tests: Clipboard contention and failure do not lose the base character
Existing PowerAccent.Common.UnitTests and PowerAccent.Core.UnitTests projects; use their existing test runner conventions.
PowerAccent.UITests/PowerAccentEndToEndTests.cs for deterministic picker/insertion behavior where environment permits.
Manual controlled WeChat/Notepad/paste matrix is required because the report target is proprietary and current logs lack emitted-code-point telemetry.
verification: Build the affected PowerAccent project(s) with the existing repository build workflow; discover the exact configuration command during implementation rather than inventing one.
Run the existing PowerAccent unit tests with Visual Studio Test Explorer or vstest.console.exe; do not use dotnet test.
Reproduce on the current release with Unicode descriptions visible, select U+300D, and capture the result.
Compare Notepad, WeChat, and literal clipboard paste, then accept only a fix branch whose commit-boundary and target evidence agree.
risks: Selection snapshot changes can regress usage sorting, wrap-around, Shift navigation, delayed reveal, or focus cancellation.
Clipboard fallback can overwrite or race with clipboard managers, fail across elevation boundaries, and leave text/modifier state inconsistent.
WeChat behavior may vary by version or IME mode, so an application heuristic could be brittle.

alternatives.option: Swap or reorder U+300C/U+300D in CharacterMappings
alternatives.reason: Both mappings are present and the report does not prove an adjacent selection; changing semantic order would mask the real cause.
It changes behavior for every target and creates clipboard/focus/elevation risks.
No target-specific transformation has been proven and target/version conditions are unknown.

confidence.rationale: The code path is confirmed, but the causal branch remains unresolved without controlled current-version evidence.

actions.label: Request current target comparison

comment.body: Thanks for the report and diagnostic archive. It confirms Quick Accent was enabled, but it does not show whether the picker selected U+300D or whether the change happens only in WeChat. Please retest on the current PowerToys release and share the exact WeChat version/install channel and active Windows input method or punctuation mode; a short recording or screenshots showing the picker Unicode description for U+300D followed by results in WeChat and Notepad; and whether pasting literal `」` into that same WeChat field remains unchanged. No additional bug-report ZIP is needed unless the behavior changes.
